name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. On the addressing class, the established VC and Littlestone dimensions both equal $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$. The surveyed sandwich theorem places Prefix-k Littlestone Dimension between them, determining the same value for every fixed k.
references: Derived from Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey and the established addressing benchmark values
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
